question: Where and how does the state of great bliss manifest?
premises: A wondrous state of great bliss follows a leftward course.
This state shines forth in the great abode of Bhairava.
That abode is consciousness which has assumed all.
inference: Therefore the state of great bliss manifests in the all-encompassing consciousness of Bhairava through a leftward mode.
uncertainties: The technical sense of 'vāmācārā' (leftward course) may carry ritual or energetic connotations.
plain_english: A wondrous state of great bliss, of leftward course, shines forth in the great abode of Bhairava, in consciousness that has taken all within itself.
